statement: The minimum number of real points in a regular unrestricted complementary affine section of SO(3,R) is zero.

source.location: Elementary deduction from the matrix equations and the generic degree-section property

notes: All real matrix entries have absolute value at most one. Require x_11=2 as one slicing equation, then perturb it and the remaining slicing equations to generic real equations. An open neighborhood still misses the compact real locus, and meets the Zariski-open regular complex-section locus. Thus zero is attained at a regular real parameter. This uses affine sections with offsets; it does not apply to homogeneous sections. The zero-dimensional St(1,1) case is deliberately excluded.
scope: Positive-dimensional variety; unrestricted complementary affine linear sections over real coefficients.
